name: Hardware Tactile
author: Grok Bot
blurb: Matte desk instrument for a local agent: warm plastic chassis, a brushed aluminum nameplate, flat phosphor segments in a recessed well, encoder knobs with an orange notch, square keys with a short lip, and a single orange run key. Clean and modern, not glossy gel and not clay.

tagline.en: Warm plastic, a phosphor well, one orange key
tagline.zh: 暖塑料机身，磷光屏，一颗橙色键

origin.author: Grok Bot
origin.note: Authored by Grok Bot. Original Hardware Tactile system. Mood only: Dieter Rams and Dietrich Lubs at Braun, where color marks a function on otherwise quiet plastic (Rams Foundation, Colors), and Teenage Engineering's machined housings, physical encoders, and orange assigned to one job. Latch-1, the palette, and the copy are original. No third-party marks, drawings, or assets.
